description: Public-procurement record of a Latvian company from the IUB (Iepirkumu uzraudzības birojs) daily open-data notices (CC0, e-forms since 2023-10-25): contracts WON (`attributions`: buyer, subject, CPV, contract reference, value in EUR, conclusion / decision / start / end dates, contract status, winner size) and notices ISSUED as a buyer (`avis_emis`), newest first, 100 each at most with `tronque_*`, totals (`nombre_attributions`, `valeur_totale_eur`, `nombre_avis_emis`) and `stock` (first and last day collected). Natural-person winners are never served, nor a buyer that is an individual merchant; `ecartes.personne_physique` (only when non-zero) counts the winners kept without identity among the awards of the listed notices. About 3% of Latvian winners are published without an identifier and the stock starts on 2023-10-25: `aucune_attribution: true` is a NON-conclusive absence. Facts only, no score. Legal persons only: an individual merchant (IK), a sole trader or a form not recognised as a legal person returns 404, not billed. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_latvian_company_public_procurement

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Latvian company public procurement (IUB)
